messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-87912) — GPU pool 'pool-a' reporting repeated OOMs on 3/5 hosts. severity=P1. metric: gpu_mem_used/pool_capacity = 96%+, >50 OOM events in 5m. link: https://pd.redwood/pd/PD-87912

pagerduty: PD-87912 triggered by alert rule 'gpu-memory-pressure-v2' -> escalation policy 'eng-oncall'. initial pager fired to rotation. paging history: page 1 delivered.

Alex Reed: acked via PD. I'm on it, grabbing recent klogs + container logs. tagging @Sam Ortiz and @Jin Park.

Sam Ortiz: thanks. quick look at pool-a memprofile: KV cache spike after specific user replay traffic; models 1 and 3 showing growth of KV cache > expected. getting tail logs now.

Alex Reed: attaching snippets from node-17 (last 2m):
```
[2026-03-15T10:02:11Z] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested 134217728)
[2026-03-15T10:02:12Z] model=llama-70b-kv variant=fp16 kv_cache_size=17.9GB
[2026-03-15T10:02:14Z] eviction_policy: none configured -> cache grew unbounded
```

Jin Park: probable root cause: a regression in kv-prefetch that skipped eviction on looped streaming requests. I have a quick mitigation: force kv-cache eviction on the pool and route new requests to quantized variant until patch.

Marta Silva: customer impact - monitoring shows ~12% of production text-gen requests to EU region returned 504/timeouts in the last 6m. Top affected customer: Acme Corp (org_id=acme-77), customer job id=1423 failing. Escalating to CS. Opening ticket: https://support.redwood/INC-4551

Alex Reed: executing mitigation now. commands:
```bash
# drain pool-a gracefully to stop scheduling new inference tasks
rwdctl pool drain pool-a --grace-period 30s
# set routing fallback for the pool to a compatible quantized variant
rwdctl routing set-fallback pool-a --model llama-70b-kv --variant quantized-8bit
# force kv cache eviction on active nodes
rwdctl exec --pool pool-a -- 'pkill -USR1 kv-evict' || true
```

Sam Ortiz: running a limited restart on nodes with highest OOM counts (node-17, node-19). will coord one-at-a-time to avoid full capacity loss.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-87912 acknowledged by Alex Reed. auto-escalation paused.

Jin Park: quick config patch we can push while debugging:
```json
{"kv_prefetch": {"enabled": true, "soft_eviction_threshold": 0.7, "hard_eviction_threshold": 0.85}}
```
I'll push as a hotfix to pool-a config and monitor.

Marta Silva: FYI support notified Acme, they see errors in their job-runner; asked for temporary mitigation (retry/backoff) guidance. I provided: set exponential backoff x4, and use streaming chunking to reduce KV growth.

Priya Nair: tagging into thread — I will take handoff in ~20m. please leave a short summary in the PD incident and note which nodes restarted + whether fallback remained active.

Alex Reed: summary saved to PD-87912: drained pool-a, set routing fallback to quantized variant, forced kv-eviction on 3 nodes, restarted node-17 and node-19 sequentially. immediate error-rate dropped from 12% -> 2% for EU pool-a traffic.

Sam Ortiz: logs look cleaner, no new OOMs in last 90s on restarted nodes. continuing to monitor. adding a 30m watch window.

pagerduty: PD-87912 annotation: mitigation actions logged. next escalation timeout disabled while acknowledged.

oncall-rotation: leaving note — handing over to @Priya Nair for stabilization period. please keep the PD incident open until we have 30m of stable metrics and kv_cache growth under control.

Priya Nair: acknowledged handoff. I'll keep an eye on GPU mem util and request a follow-up postmortem if growth recurs. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Auto-monitoring: scheduled snapshot of pool-a metrics in 10m. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-memory-oom (see 'eviction + fallback' section).

Alex Reed: leaving a short TODO for post-handoff: 1) revert temporary routing after stable period, 2) deploy kv-prefetch fix with unit test for eviction, 3) run synthetic workload to validate behavior.

Priya Nair: closing thread for now; will re-open if OOMs reappear. monitoring window started at 1769532123 -> will end by 1769534323 if stable. :white_check_mark:
